highlights: Record revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24% year over year, record GAAP earnings per share of $1.14, up 58% year over year, and record non-GAAP earnings per share of $1.40, up 40% year over year – Cisco’s strongest revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share growth rates in over 15 years
GAAP EPS increased 58% year over year
Raised expectation for AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers to $9B in FY27, more than double the total for FY26

quotes.text: In Q1, we delivered the strongest revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share growth rates for Cisco in over 15 years.
quotes.by: Chuck Robbins, chair and CEO of Cisco

quotes.text: Q1 FY27 was another record quarter for Cisco, with revenue, non-GAAP operating margin, and non-GAAP EPS all exceeding the high end of our guidance ranges. The strength of our Q1 performance gives us confidence to raise our revenue and non-GAAP EPS guidance for FY27.
